page.overview:
Who is Eaedalus Okiro?

Eaedalus Okiro is the Alcald of Cathmoíra, as well as the older brother of Nydas Okiro and a friend of Zerxus Ilerez. As an NPC, Eaedalus is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Eaedalus is a large and handsome human man, muscular and with a big stomach. Like his brother, he has a beard, and his is long and bushy.

In his youth Eaedalus was more realistic than Nydas, and he grew up to be a responsible and trustworthy man, able to manage stressful situations.

Eaedalus and Nydas lived part of their younger years in Cathmoíra, Domunas, where they met Zerxus Ilerez. When they were young boys they spent time in ships, while dreaming about living in floating cities such as Avalir;
